params.name: concern
params.default: correctness, missed edge cases, and anything the first engineer talked themselves into
params.description: What the second opinion should focus on

data.text:
OUTCOME: a critical review from a tool that did not do the work.

YOU SUPPLY:
• SLOT — drag the finished session onto ❝ and wire it in
• --dir → the repository (the reviewer verifies claims on disk)
• a model on the agent

Default agent is Claude (general-purpose). If the session under review was already Claude, swap this node to Cursor or opencode — the point is a different provider with no sunk cost.

Guards: content breaker, $1 ceiling, approval.

config.extraInstructions: Summarize what was attempted, what was decided and why, what was actually changed, and anything left unresolved. Keep the reasoning, drop the chatter.

data.template:
Another engineer did the work summarized below. You were not involved and have no stake in it.

Review it critically for {{param:concern}}.

Rules:
- Verify claims against the actual repository rather than trusting the summary.
- Say plainly if the approach is sound; do not manufacture objections.
- Rank what you find by what would actually bite in production.

--- SUMMARY OF THEIR WORK ---

{{input}}
